           SECTION I:  INSTRUCTIONS TO TENDERERS 
 A General Provisions 
 1. Scope of T e n d e r 
1.1 The  Procuring  Entity  as  defined  in the  TDS  invites  tenders  for  supply  of  goods  and,  if  applicable,  
any Related  Services  incidental  thereto,  as  specified  in  Section  V,  Supply  Requirements.  The  
name, identification,  and  number  of  lots  (contracts)  of  this  Tender  Document  are  specified  in  
the  TDS. 
 1.2 Throughout this tendering document: 
a) the  term  “in  writing”  means  communica ted  in  written  form  (e.g.  by  mail,  e -mail,  fax,  
including  if specified  in  the  TDS,  distributed  or  received  through  the  electronic-procurement  
system  used  by  the 
Procuring Entity) with proof of receipt; 
b) if  the  context  so  requires,  “singular”  means  “plural”  and  vice  versa; 
c) “Day” means calendar day, unless otherwise specified as “Business Day”.  A  Business  Day  is  any  
day  that is  an  official  working  day  of  the  Procuring  Entity.  It excludes official public holidays. 
 2. Fraud and Corruption 
2.1 The    Procuring    Entity    requires    compliance    with    the  provisions  of  the  Public  Procurement  
and  Asset Disposal  Act,  2015,  Section  62  “Declaration  not  to  engage  in  corruption”.  The  tender  
submitted  by  a person  shall  include  a  declaration  that  the  person  shall  not  engage  in  any  corrupt
